detailed_description:
The target video is a living two-color risograph print in <Subject 1>: every shape keeps its orange and blue ink grain, hatching and slight misregistration as it moves, like animated screen-printed frames.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The cut wire around the hole trembles and the flare glow pulses through the gap. The camera pushes forward through the torn hole at a steady speed in one continuous move, the curled wire sliding past the edges of the frame, through the glowing smoke and out the other side, where a huge crowd of silhouettes marches away down the wide road carrying plain flags and lit flares toward the horizon. The camera is still moving forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
